title: Year of The Dragon, 50 dollars
descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of life energy and positive changes Highest purity gold – symbol of power and abundance Refined addition to any prestigious collection Excellent gift, expressing wishes for prosperity and growth The Gold Coin of the Wooden Dragon Year is a unique symbol of power and abundance. Struck from the highest purity gold, it’s a true collector’s gem and a testament to minting craftsmanship. It combines the strength of the imperial Dragon and the dynamism of wood, offering a promise of growth and wealth that the new year in the Chinese Calendar brings with it.
